title: WPMS/1330/2015 of Chandra Shekhar Arora Vs Zila Panchayat Dehradun

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1330 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Ms. Prabha Naithani, Advocate for
the petitioner.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for the
respondent.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned counsel for
the Zila Panchayat, has handed over site
map, which was got prepared before the
commencement of the construction of the
complex. As per the site map, area in
question was reserved for public
urinal/toilet.
It is settled position of law that place
reserved for public utility cannot be allotted
either for commercial activities or for any
other purpose ignoring the public
utility/public need. Therefore, alleged
allotment made in favour of the petitioner
was without jurisdiction, which seems to
have been correctly revoked/recalled.
Consequently, petition fails and is
hereby dismissed.
CLMA No. 6476 of 2015 also stands
disposed of accordingly.
(Alok Singh, J.)
Dated :24.06.2015
Avneet/
